parts.note: something trendy is said to be in, i.e. fashionable
a vocation is a calling or career

explanation.surface: Someone is attracted to a fashionable line of work.
explanation.definitionFit: An invocation is an earnest appeal or calling upon someone, often a deity, for help.

clue.text: Organised riots in the Netherlands airport?

indicators.note: the shuffled letters sit inside the country code, so in signals a container here

parts.note: NL is the international code for the Netherlands

indicators.note: organised means arranged into order, so the letters of riots are rearranged

explanation.surface: Planned unrest breaks out at a Dutch airport such as Schiphol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organised' rearranges RIOTS into OSTRI, which goes 'in' NL. The question mark flags the playful definition: a nostril is a port for air.
explanation.definitionFit: A whimsical reading: a nostril is literally an opening through which air passes, a port for air.

parts.note: a machine that is on is working
a set is a group or class, as of pupils

explanation.surface: Industrial workers launch an assault.
explanation.definitionFit: An onset is the start of an assault, an attack, as in the onset of the enemy.

clue.text: Operatic heroine hides in a barrel? Strange!

indicators.note: one piece concealing itself within another signals putting it inside

parts.note: bl is the standard abbreviation for barrel
Norma is the title heroine of Bellini's opera

explanation.surface: A soprano crouches inside a cask, which is odd behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Something abnormal departs from the usual, so it is odd or strange.

clue.text: How extreme viewpoints are committed to paper

definitions.text: How extreme viewpoints are committed to paper

parts.words: How extreme viewpoints are committed to paper
parts.note: extreme views see everything as one colour or its opposite with no grey, and writing puts dark ink onto pale paper

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means written down or printed, ink on paper, and also suggests seeing things with no shades of grey.

definitions.meaning: Horatio ..., the British admiral who won at Trafalgar
a wrestling hold applied from behind under the arms

explanation.definitionFit: Admiral Nelson was the famous naval commander, and a nelson is a grip in wrestling.

clue.text: Sailing vessel departs! In what manner?

parts.note: d is the abbreviation for departs in timetables
how asks in what manner

explanation.surface: Someone sees a boat leave and asks how it managed it.
explanation.definitionFit: A dhow is a traditional Arab sailing boat with a lateen sail.

indicators.note: one thing happening during another sits within it, so the abbreviation goes inside

parts.note: a disease is an illness
PL is the abbreviation for Poet Laureate

explanation.surface: The official national poet is distressed while sick.
explanation.definitionFit: To displease someone is to annoy or upset them; the verb sense is used here.

parts.note: out, as in out of date, means no longer fashionable
post is a synonym of mail

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned letters are sent to a distant colony.
explanation.definitionFit: An outpost is a small settlement or station in a distant or remote place.

indicators.note: losing something means it is taken away, so letters are removed

parts.note: a crisis is a time of trouble
CR is the abbreviation for credit in accounts

explanation.surface: A deity in difficulties has her rating cut.
explanation.definitionFit: Isis was the chief goddess of ancient Egypt, wife of Osiris.

clue.text: Bounty lies wrecked in the mist

indicators.note: something wrecked is broken up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: HMS Bounty, the famous mutiny ship, lies broken in the fog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrecked' rearranges BOUNTY LIES into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Nebulosity is cloudiness or haziness, the state of being misty.

parts.note: crate is slang for a battered old car, a jalopy
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: An old banger drives into a pothole.
explanation.definitionFit: A crater is a large hollow or hole in the ground, as made by a bomb.

clue.text: A girl concerned with the Devil

parts.note: Polly is a girl's name
on means about or concerned with, as in a book on birds

explanation.surface: A young woman is involved with Satan.
explanation.definitionFit: Apollyon, the destroyer in Revelation, is the devilish fiend fought by Christian in The Pilgrim's Progress.

parts.note: a stew is a state of agitation, as is a flap
a jack is a device that props up a car such as a Ferrari

explanation.surface: An agitated fan of the racing team eats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ferrari supporter' looks like a fan of the team; it is the car jack that holds the car up. A flapjack is a British oat bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A flapjack is a baked oat bar in Britain and a pancake in America, either way a food.

indicators.note: to tour is to go around, so the friend surrounds the other letters

parts.note: a pal is a friend

indicators.note: a compound is a mixture, so the letters of Arctic are mixed up

explanation.surface: A sensible companion travelled round a polar settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arctic' looks like the polar region, but 'compound' makes it anagram fodder, and 'toured' wraps the friend around the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A practical person is sensible and realistic, down-to-earth.

definitions.meaning: does things or plays a role on stage
the ... of the Apostles is the New Testament book immediately following John's Gospel

explanation.definitionFit: The word means does or performs, and also names the Bible book placed right after John.

parts.note: a brace is a pair or couple, as of birds
to let is to rent or hire out

explanation.surface: A pair rent out their gems.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracelet is an ornamental band worn on the wrist, an item of jewellery.

clue.text: Star found in an active galaxy

indicators.note: a word found inside other words is lying hidden within their letters

explanation.surface: Astronomers locate a sun in a lively galaxy.
explanation.definitionFit: Vega is one of the brightest stars in the night sky, in the constellation Lyra.

indicators.note: stirring mixes things up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A spiteful girl mixes up the golden syrup.
explanation.definitionFit: Electra, daughter of Agamemnon in Greek myth, helped avenge her father's murder.

clue.text: Scandinavian orchestra leader admitted to bad manners

indicators.note: being admitted to a place puts one inside it
bad suggests disorder, so the letters of manners are rearranged
the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The head of an orchestra puts up with rude behaviour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges MANNERS into NRSEMAN, and the first letter of orchestra ('leader') is 'admitted to' it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Norseman is a man from ancient Scandinavia, a Viking.

clue.text: In the morning Heather is continent

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning
Erica is the botanical genus of heather, and a girl's name

explanation.surface: A woman named Heather is self-restrained early in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'continent' looks like the adjective meaning self-restrained; it is the landmass.
explanation.definitionFit: America, North or South, is one of the great landmasses.

parts.note: asps are venomous snakes

explanation.surface: A Greek snake handler seizes the reptiles.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp something is to seize or get hold of it firmly.

clue.text: Delaware atomic project? That's the last place to live!

parts.note: DE is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Delaware
A stands for atomic, as in A-bomb
to project is to throw

explanation.surface: A nuclear programme in an American state is no place to settle.
explanation.definitionFit: Death row is the prison block holding those awaiting execution, so it is literally the final place they live.

indicators.note: reportedly signals a word heard rather than seen, so we go by sound

parts.note: a hacker is one with a hacking cough, a cougher

explanation.walkthrough: 'Hacker' wants to be a computer intruder; it is someone with a hacking cough.
explanation.definitionFit: A coffer is a strongbox for valuables, much like a safe.

parts.note: Florida, the Sunshine State, is abbreviated FL
to air views is to utter them

explanation.surface: Florida's total style is admired.
explanation.definitionFit: Flair is stylish distinctiveness, close in sense to panache.

clue.text: Keeps old Ford laid up and motionless

parts.note: a shop that stocks goods keeps them
the Model T was the old Ford car
someone laid up is in bed ill

explanation.surface: A collector stores a vintage car that sits unused in the garage.
explanation.definitionFit: Stock-still means completely still, utterly motionless.

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
to rid is to free, as in rid of pests

explanation.surface: A dull newspaper piece is given away at no cost.
explanation.definitionFit: Arid writing or talk is dry and dull, hence tedious.

definitions.meaning: to call out to or greet someone
frozen pellets of ice falling as precipitation

explanation.definitionFit: To hail is to call out to someone, and hail is also icy precipitation, poor weather.

parts.note: sweet and dear both mean lovable
bread is slang for money

explanation.surface: A precious item can only be had for cash.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweetbread is the pancreas or thymus of a calf or lamb, eaten as food.
